name: Managed Chrome --app & MV3 Bridge
author: OmniDesk
description: 托管系统原生 Chrome --app 阅读/登录窗，提供只读 Cookies SQLite 同步与受限 127.0.0.1 CDP DOM 提取/同源 fetch 桥接。

config_schema.label: Chrome 可执行文件
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH (or 'auto') or absolute path to Chrome/Chromium

config_schema.label: 受管 Profile 目录（可选）
启用内置 MV3 扩展
config_schema.description: Load the bundled local MV3 extension via --load-extension when launching Chrome --app

config_schema.label: 本地 CDP 端口 (127.0.0.1)
config_schema.description: Loopback-only (127.0.0.1) Chrome DevTools Protocol port; 0 disables remote debugging flag

config_schema.label: Cookie 导入目标
config_schema.description: Persist imported cookies to 0600 SecretVault, an isolated 0600 file, or both

config_schema.label: Cookie 导入文件路径（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional 0600 JSON output path when cookie_import_target includes 'file'

config_schema.label: 单次 Fetch 响应上限 (字节)
config_schema.description: Maximum allowed response size in bytes for web.fetch.v1 (default 8 MiB)

config_schema.label: CDP 请求超时 (毫秒)
config_schema.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for CDP extract and same-origin fetch operations
